items.title: Juruaia (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #004
items.en_title: Juruaia (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #004
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Juruaia (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 173,580; proposals close Nov 26, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
